band490.cleaning: Components filter+optics+qe (was filter+optics+qe in the manifest, the manifest listed this curve as its own filter component): NASA OBPG's table seawifs_rsrs.txt ('Spectral response functions for SeaWiFS', https://oceandata.sci.gsfc.nasa.gov/rsr_tables/images/rsr/seawifs_rsrs.txt) gives each band's whole-instrument relative spectral response; Barnes et al. 1994, SeaWiFS Technical Report Series Vol. 23 (NASA TM 104566, 'SeaWiFS Prelaunch Radiometric Calibration and Spectral Characterization', https://oceancolor.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/resources/seawifs/PreLVol23.pdf), built the band responses from 'measurements of individual parts in the instrument's optical train' (interference filter, mirrors, dichroics, broadband filters, photodiode); no filter-only curve is published as data (copies in source_evidence/components-20261127/) (Nill, 27 Nov 2026, 'Correct the labels').
